changes: Shared capture/decide/plan/act/review flow through Home, Today, Thoughts, Tasks and Notes; purpose-grouped app directory
Thoughts stay separate until explicit task promotion; stable source tokens preserve chosen actions across phone and web
Task details link exact-task Focus, local Calendar reservations and Activity completion; drafts and source Back routes persist
Pocket Calendar uses local storage without Google Calendar provider permissions; optional Drive transport retains six shared collections
Browser Pip with conversation navigation, Markdown streaming, separate reasoning, context cards and bottom composer; Pocket design on phone and web
Explicit Thought/Task/Note snapshots accompany chat messages; keep note, park thought, make task and copy actions
Matching pixel mascot waves, walks, juggles, reads and hops; animation pauses with reduced motion and hidden/detached views
Unnecessary inline helpers removed from workspace, capture and chat screens
Earlier camera rendering and format/aspect/JPEG options, centered Home readings and shared motion/design controls retained
known_limits: The release APK is unsigned; another agent handles signing before installation.
Final test suite skipped at the user's request; final lint not run.
Nothing Phone (3a) gestures, animation smoothness, camera frames, cellular delivery and live account synchronization remain unverified.
Android/Nothing OS controls Recents and Home gestures; no full custom ROM was built.
Pip chats stay local to each device, outside Drive; browser data removal or app uninstall removes local conversations.
Compatible browser API endpoints must support CORS; native Pocket tool lookups are not offered in the browser.
Camera tuning used existing phone JPEGs rather than real Pocket YUV captures and may need handset retuning.
changes_in_0_6_1: Static original pixel sky for native Home/Today and browser Today, using matching ordered-dither formulas and Pocket's accent palette
Artwork fades to black and keeps the left side subdued behind clock/title text; lists and editors retain plain backgrounds
Android caches the bitmap by size, the browser repaints on resize and disposes its observer on route changes; no background requests or animation loop
No data schema or sync-scope changes from 0.6.0
